question: Who is the writer of the novel 'A Suitable Boy'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Seth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vikram Seth** is the author of the novel **'A Suitable Boy'**, which was published in 1993.
 
• The novel is one of the longest novels ever published in a single volume in the English language, consisting of 1349 pages.
 
• 'A Suitable Boy' explores the story of a young girl, Lata, and her quest to find a suitable husband, set in the post-independence, post-partition era of India.
 
• The novel is well-regarded for its detailed portrayal of Indian society and the complex relationships between its characters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vikram Seth** is an Indian novelist and poet, born on 20 June 1952 in Calcutta, India.
 
• He has also written other notable works such as 'The Golden Gate' (1986), a novel in verse form, and 'An Equal Music' (1999), a novel about the lives of classical musicians.
 
• 'A Suitable Boy' was adapted into a television drama series by the BBC in 2020, directed by Mira Nair.
 
• Seth has received several awards for his literary work, including the Padma Shri, one of India's highest civilian honors, in 2007.
 
• In addition to his novels, Vikram Seth has published several collections of poetry, including 'Mappings' (1980) and 'All You Who Sleep Tonight' (1990).
